// diagnostic

E0742

This `{method}` impl uses the effect `{effect}`, which the trait doesn't allow.

What

This `{method}` impl uses the effect `{effect}`, which the trait doesn't allow.

Why

A trait method may declare an effect upper bound (`fn hash(self) -[]>`, `fn render(self) -[GPU]>`); every implementation's inferred effects must fit inside it, so the bound holds for all impls (D-EFF3).

Fix

remove the offending work from the impl, or widen the bound on the trait method.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0742: tests/ui/effect_trait_impl_bound.stderr.

Error [E0742]: this `hash` impl uses the effect `FS`, which the trait doesn't allow
  --> tests/ui/effect_trait_impl_bound.jet:12:8
    |
 12 |     fn hash(self) Int -> {
    |        ^^^^
 Why: `Hasher` bounds `hash` to `-[]>`, so impls must be pure; `FS` is outside that bound
 Fix: remove the `FS` work from this impl, or widen the bound on the trait method
